‎The Ondo State chapter of the All Progressives Congress has assured that the party would win the presidential, national and state assembly elections in the state. ‎The Director-General of the Ondo State APC Presidential Campaign Council, Mr Victor Olabimtan, made the declaration while speaking with journalists in Akure, the state capital, on Tuesday. ‎The APC chieftain said the party members across the 18 Local Government Areas of the state were already working towards achieving victory for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election in 2027. Olabimtan added that the party would also win all seats across the state’s three senatorial districts, nine federal constituencies and 26-member House of Assembly. ‎”We will achieve our target of securing one million votes for President Bola Tinubu in Ondo State, as we have started the grassroots mobilisation strategy. 2027: Tinubu promises Nigerians reliable power supply 2027: APC unveils four-pillar manifesto for Tinubu’s second term bid Tinubu inaugurates reconstructed Lagos governor’s lodge in Abuja ‎”The party has mobilised 25 voters in each of its 3,962 polling units, with each person expected to bring five additional voters. The one-million-vote target is achievable, and by the grace of God, we are going to reach it,” he boasted. ‎On the purported division in the party, Olabimtan said the party leadership had taken steps to reconcile aggrieved members, expressing confidence that the party would work together to secure victory for Tinubu and other candidates in the 2027 general elections. ‎He added that the presidential campaign scheduled to hold in Akure on Wednesday would bring together all party leaders and members, saying the party had resolved its internal differences and was ready to present a united front ahead of the presidential rally. ‎‎”Although the APC family may appear divided from the outside, we know how to resolve our differences. Those differences are being addressed, and I assure you that we are campaigning together,” he said. ‎ ‎He disclosed that after the rally, the state governor, Lucky Aiyedatiwa, would commence a campaign tour across the LGAs to be accompanied by candidates contesting the Senate, House of Representatives, and state House of Assembly elections.
